incomeHandling: Preserve valid negative household income. Never treat -9 income as generic missing; -6 is documented not-applicable and will be investigated if seen in the owner universe.
baseCostStatistics: Retain known nonnegative JOBCOST including zero and integer 1. Also compute a sensitivity excluding 1 because the official instrument uses it for costs already reported in another job; this is not a verified recode into the PUF.
completion: All reported projects for core frequency/share analysis, including unfinished. Separate completed-only and cost-flag-0 sensitivities; flags described literally until definitions verified.
frequency: Homes with >=1 professional-category project per1000 all occupied owner homes; homes without projects retained
shares: Project-count and nonnegative-reported-spending denominators separately; unknowns preserved
quantiles: Inverse weighted empirical CDF; quartiles and median, Fay BRR replicate approximation with 90% normal intervals; not assumed identical to Census median interpolation
adjustedAgeAssociation: Household weighted linear probability model, age-group indicators plus prespecified income-band and Census-division indicators; outcome per1000 homes. Fay BRR coefficients. Descriptive conditional association, no causal or individual predictive claim.
